description: This file defines the 'MessageSendNotAllowedException', a specific exception class used within the Eclipse Ditto project. It signifies that sending a message failed due to missing permissions or non-existent target. The class includes constructors, static factory methods, JSON deserialization, and a nested builder class to facilitate exception creation and handling.
